___TEMPLATE_INFO___.description: This is a TEMPLATE for ChatFlow workflow files
___TEMPLATE_INFO___.purpose: Shows how to structure tasks and workflows for automation
___TEMPLATE_INFO___.usage: Copy this to workflow_XXX.json and fill with YOUR tasks
___TEMPLATE_INFO___.git_status: Real workflow files are NOT committed, use this template for documentation

___HOW_TO_USE_THIS_TEMPLATE___.step_2: Edit the JSON to add your own tasks
___HOW_TO_USE_THIS_TEMPLATE___.step_3: Add each task with: task_id, prompt, adapter, variables
___HOW_TO_USE_THIS_TEMPLATE___.step_5: Load in GUI or CLI to execute
___HOW_TO_USE_THIS_TEMPLATE___.step_6: Results will be saved to data/results/session_TIMESTAMP.json

___workflow_id___: Unique identifier for this workflow - use for organizational purposes
name: Customer Support Analysis
description: Analyzes customer feedback using different AI models for comprehensive insights
___description___: Long description of what this workflow does
___created_at___: ISO 8601 timestamp when workflow was created
___tags___: Optional array of tags for organizing workflows

variables.___SECTION___: Global variables that can be used in prompts with {variable_name} syntax

feedback.example: Great product but documentation needs improvement

tasks.___id___: Unique task identifier within this workflow
tasks.name: Summarize Feedback
tasks.prompt: Please summarize the following customer feedback in 2-3 sentences: {feedback}
tasks.___prompt___: The text to send to AI. Use {variable_name} for variable substitution
tasks.___adapter___: Which AI adapter to use: chatgpt, claude, genspark, qwen, or generic
tasks.___timeout___: Max seconds to wait for response (default 120)
tasks.___retries___: Number of retry attempts if task fails (default 2)
tasks.___order___: Execution order (tasks execute in ascending order of this field)

tasks.___TASK_2___: Task with dependencies (waits for task_001 to complete first)
tasks.name: Classify Sentiment
tasks.prompt: Based on this feedback, classify the sentiment as positive, negative, or neutral: {feedback}
tasks.___depends_on___: Array of task IDs that must complete before this task runs
tasks.___pass_previous___: true = pass previous task output as context, false = use only current prompt

tasks.___TASK_3___: Task using Claude adapter instead of ChatGPT
tasks.name: Extract Keywords
tasks.prompt: List the top 5 keywords from this feedback, categorized as positive/negative: {feedback}
tasks.___adapter_change___: This task switches to Claude model for comparison

tasks.name: Detailed Analysis
tasks.prompt:
Provide detailed analysis in {language} of this feedback: {feedback}
Keep response under {max_tokens} tokens.
tasks.___multiple_dependencies___: Waits for both task_002 AND task_003 to complete
tasks.___pass_previous_true___: Will include outputs from task_002 and task_003 as context

tasks.name: Similar Issues Research
tasks.___genspark_note___: GenSpark is good for research tasks (includes web search)

tasks.___TASK_6___: Task using generic adapter for unknown site
tasks.name: Summary in Generic Chat
tasks.___generic___: Use generic adapter if targeting unknown/custom chat interfaces

execution_config.___parallel___: true = run tasks in parallel (be careful with order/dependencies), false = sequential
execution_config.___interval___: Seconds to wait between tasks (avoid rate limiting)
execution_config.___stop_on_error___: true = stop workflow if any task fails, false = continue with remaining tasks
execution_config.___save_intermediate___: true = save results after each task, false = save only at end

___IMPORTANT_NOTES___.note_1: Task IDs must be unique within the workflow
___IMPORTANT_NOTES___.note_5: Adapters must match those configured in config.json
___IMPORTANT_NOTES___.note_6: Timeout should be longer for complex queries
___IMPORTANT_NOTES___.note_7: Retries help handle temporary network issues
___IMPORTANT_NOTES___.note_9: Real workflow files go in data/tasks/ folder
